motivation: Audit CYCLE_36028392571 finding 4: extend the v25 174k conformance gate with a per-representation v17b provenance check so the copy-defect class discovered in producer run 36013963912 (regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.5/0.7 v17b files byte-identical to full_text_tfidf_light) is caught mechanically by a future conformance gate instead of by auditor luck.
benchmark_code: FROZEN functions imported from evaluation/experiments/v25_174k_suite/run_v25_174k_suite.py (bm_hierarchy, bm_zoom, bm_legal_area, normalize_labels, load_metadata) - NOT reimplemented. Frozen pipeline parameters, random_state=42, n_init=10, subsample = fixed hierarchy_subsample_15000_seed42.
embeddings: results/evaluation/v25_174k_formal_suite/embeddings/{rep}.npy (173,963 x 128 float32, snapshot verified bitwise-exact rebuild)

reference_sets.recorded: results/evaluation/v25_174k_v17b/{rep}.json (producer run 36013963912; contains documented h5/h7 copy defect)

P1_own_embedding_correspondence.rule: For each (rep, reference_set): recompute the 6 v17b metric groups (raw + normalized x hierarchy_coherence / zoom_coherence / legal_area_clustering) from the rep's OWN saved embedding on the frozen subsample using the frozen benchmark functions. Compare all 14 numerical fields (best_purity, best_nmi, coarse_purity, fine_purity, improvement_pct, overall_purity, nmi per raw/normalized) against the file. FAIL if any |delta| > 0.02 absolute.
P1_own_embedding_correspondence.rationale: Audit CYCLE_36028392571 3.6 measured benign environment drift (sklearn/BLAS) at <= ~1e-3 to ~1e-2 on these metrics; 0.02 provides 2-20x headroom while remaining far below material corruption deltas (metric differences between genuinely different representations are 0.05-0.5, e.g. hierarchy purity 0.152 vs 0.465).

P2_file_identity_implies_on_sample_embed.rule: For every pair (R1,R2) whose reference files have IDENTICAL metric content (all 14 numerical fields exactly equal): assert max_abs_diff(emb[R1][hier_idx], emb[R2][hier_idx]) <= 1e-4. FAIL otherwise: two different on-sample embeddings cannot yield byte-identical measurement files unless one file was copied.

P3_degeneracy_probe.rule: For every identical-file pair (R1,R2): build a fixed probe = seed-42 subsample of 10,000 rows among rows whose regeste_tfidf base embedding is non-zero (rows where regeste hybrids genuinely differ from full_text). Compute max_abs_diff(emb[R1][probe], emb[R2][probe]). If > 1e-3, record WARN 'file equality not explained by probe embedding equality - measurement provenance must be documented (degenerate-sample copy class)'. Warnings are recorded in the gate report and do not change pass/fail.

P4_status_consistency.rule: For each (rep, reference_set): the status field (PASS/FAIL/SKIP) of each recomputed metric group must equal the status in the reference file. FAIL otherwise (threshold-boundary inconsistency indicates a corrupted file).
P4_status_consistency.note: Statuses derive from frozen thresholds; benign drift is far from thresholds, so a status mismatch cannot be explained by environment noise.

frozen_expectation.P1: PASS for all 8 reps on both reference sets. For regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.5/0.7 this PASS holds by numerical coincidence: all 15,000 frozen subsample rows are regeste-zero rows on which hybrid emb == full_text emb (documented in CYCLE_36028392571 3.7).
frozen_expectation.P2: PASS. Exactly one identical-content group exists: {full_text_tfidf_light, regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.5, regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.7} (3 members) on both reference sets; their on-sample embeddings are identical by degeneracy.
frozen_expectation.P3: WARN entries for all 3 pairwise combinations within the degenerate triple on both reference sets (probe embeddings differ materially: max_abs_diff ~0.1-0.9 per audit 3.7 'max diff 0.878, 48% of rows'). All other pairs: no WARN (files differ).
frozen_expectation.P4: PASS for all 8 reps on both reference sets.

NC_swap_corruption_matrix.rule: For every ordered pair (victim, donor) among the 8 reps whose recorded files are NOT identical: simulate corruption by writing donor's recorded metric content into victim's slot and require P1 to FAIL (at least one |delta| > 0.02 vs victim's own-embedding recomputation). For pairs within the degenerate triple {full_text_tfidf_light, regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.5, regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.7}, swaps are expected PASS with P3 WARN (corruption numerically invisible - documented degeneracy).
NC_swap_corruption_matrix.requirement: 0 unexpected PASSes in the non-degenerate swap cells; swap cells within the triple may pass with WARN.

NC_file_identity_with_different_embeddin.rule: For every ordered pair (victim, donor) with non-identical recorded files: crafting victim's file to equal donor's file must cause P2 to FAIL, because victim's on-sample embeddings differ from donor's.
NC_file_identity_with_different_embeddin.requirement: P2 FAIL for all such pairs (by construction of P2).

success_rule: Main gate: P1/P2/P4 PASS on both reference sets; P3 WARNs confined to the degenerate triple.
Negative controls: NC_swap_corruption_matrix has 0 unexpected PASSes; NC_file_identity_with_different_embeddings FAILs everywhere expected.
Gate output lands in results/evaluation/v25_174k_provenance_gate_36035803010/ with raw per-rep recomputations preserved.
no_tuning_rule: No rule, tolerance, sample, probe or threshold is adjusted after observing results.
